title: Easy Sit Vanilla
description:

body:
## 🪑 Easy Sit – Sit Anywhere Datapack

Tired of standing all the time?
With **Easy Sit**, you can sit **anywhere in your world** using a simple command.

### ✨ Features

✔ Sit on **any solid block**
✔ Works in **survival & multiplayer**
✔ Super easy: `/trigger sit`
✔ No mods required
✔ Lightweight & lag-free

### 🚫 Smart Restrictions

* ❌ Cannot sit in air
* ❌ Cannot sit on water or lava
* ✔ Only works on valid blocks (no glitches)

### 🎮 How to Use

Type:
/trigger sit

That’s it. You sit instantly.

### 📦 Installation

1. Download the datapack
2. Put it in:

.minecraft/saves/<your_world>/datapacks/

3. Run:
/reload

### 💡 Why This Datapack?

Most sit datapacks are:

* Complicated ❌
* Buggy ❌
* Overengineered ❌

**Easy Sit is simple, fast, and just works.**
